      "ref": "[D42]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "The ESRB and PEGI age ratings are used to indicate suitability for children, with specific age thresholds (e.g., ESRB EC for ages 3+, PEGI 3 for all ages).",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "In the United States, Canada and Mexico, the ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) system is used to help distinguish what games are suitable for different ages and in the UK and most European countries the PEGI (Pan European Games Information) system is used."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D42]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "The ESRB EC rating is suitable for children aged 3 or older and contains no inappropriate content.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "EC | Early Childhood. Suitable for children aged 3 or older, there will be no inappropriate content. E.g. Dora the Explorer, Dragon Tales."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D42]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "The ESRB E rating is suitable for all age groups and should not contain any sounds or images likely to scare young children.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "E | Suitable for all age groups. The game should not contain any sounds or images likely to scare young children. No bad language should be used. E.g. Just Dance, FIFA."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[D42]",
      "area": "age_gating",

      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "E 10+ | Suitable for those aged 10 or above. There could be mild forms of violence, and some scenes might be frightening for children. E.g. Minecraft Dungeons, Plants vs Zombies."
    },

      "quote": "M | Suitable for those aged 17 or above. This rating is used when the violence becomes realistic and would be expected in real life. Bad language, and the use of tobacco, alcohol or illegal drugs can also be present. E.g. Ark: Survival Evolved, Destiny 2."
    },
